description: Agent Knowledge: submit one knowledge report written for a principal, saying what the agent knows and what it is unsure of: its title, its audience, its headline as written and optionally its text; whether it states the claimed topics with no entries, the entries past their review date, the facts resting on one source and the claims their cited sources do not support, where each sits (beside the headline, in a later section, in an appendix or in a separate document) and how many it names; and optionally the record of each, as found by the coverage, freshness, source and grounding checks. The signed report says what sits beside the headline, checks every count against the record, and names a report that smooths over what the agent does not know: gaps, stale entries, single-source facts or unsupported claims left out, or stated as none against a record that holds some; then counts below the record’s, disclosures in an appendix or a separate document, and wording that calls the knowledge complete, comprehensive, up to date or verified while the record holds unknowns, with the fix for each. An observability summary for a principal is wever_observability-report-check, a reputation summary for a buyer is wever_reputation-report-check and classifying the failures a recorded run absorbed against its outcome is wever_trace-outcome-brief. Verdict gaps_smoothed_over, candor_gaps, candor_unverified or unknowns_disclosed. POST /api/knowledge-report-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-knowledge-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-knowledge/.
